papers.title: MemReread: Enhancing Agentic Long-Context Reasoning via Memory-Guided Rereading
papers.what: A streaming long-context reader that drops retrieval and instead decomposes the question and rereads the source when its running memory is insufficient, with an RL controller setting the number of rereading passes at linear cost.

papers.title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
papers.what: A benchmark that isolates agent memory and scores it under self-evolving conditions, separating in-episode from cross-episode memory rather than reporting one aggregate end-task score.

papers.title: The Efficiency Frontier: A Unified Framework for Cost-Performance Optimization in LLM Context Management
papers.what: Frames LLM context management as a single cost-performance optimization, characterizing the non-dominated set of context strategies so a system can pick a point on the frontier instead of using ad hoc truncation or summarization rules.

papers.title: CogOmniControl: Reasoning-Driven Controllable Video Generation via Creative Intent Cognition
papers.what: Factorizes controllable video generation into a creative-intent reasoning stage followed by diffusion generation conditioned on the inferred intent, improving control for abstract or underspecified prompts.
